subject: Post-demo: Northstar security checklist & log / deletion scope
message_1_subject: Post-demo: Northstar security checklist & log / deletion scope
message_1_body:
Thanks for the demo earlier — appreciate the time, Liam and Amira. Quick recap from our side and a couple of specific asks so we can keep the procurement path moving:

Summary of what we covered:
- High-level architecture and where customer data is processed (inference calls via Redwood-hosted runtime).
- Data classification: you clarified that some user metadata and medical device telemetry will be in scope.
- Compliance priorities: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR mapping, and HIPAA for a subset of records.

Asks / follow-ups we promised:
1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether Northstar requires a current SOC 2 report for vendor onboarding or an attestation of SOC 2 controls in the meantime? We attached a short Redwood SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
2) Vendor questionnaire (VSA): please either attach your vendor security questionnaire or confirm if you want Redwood to initiate the VSA on your portal. We can also send a pre-filled questionnaire to speed things up.
3) Log & backup retention scope: please confirm the retention periods you require for:
   - Application audit logs (events/requests)
   - System logs / host logs / access logs
   - Backups (database snapshots and object-store backups)
   - Whether backups may contain PHI and any special retention or deletion windows for PHI vs non-PHI.

Initial Redwood proposals (to speed review):
- Default audit log retention: 13 months (we can adjust to contractually match your needs).
- Backup snapshots: rolling 90 days; long-term archival only on explicit agreement.
- Deletion SLA for user-requested data: up to 30 days after validated request for non-PHI; PHI deletion timelines may require extended coordination.

Next steps we propose:
- Liam/Amira: send your VSA or confirm where we should upload answers. If you want, Ben can pre-fill the common sections.
- We can set a 30-minute compliance call this week to confirm RTO/RPO expectations and encryption/KMS details.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (short control mapping).

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(e) evelyn_hart@redwood.com | (m) +1-415-555-0124
message_2_subject: Re: Post-demo: Northstar security checklist & log / deletion scope
message_2_body:
Thanks, Evelyn — great summary and helpful to have proposals up front. High level answers from our side below; we'll attach our initial VSA as well (northstar-vsa-initiated.pdf).

SOC 2: We require a SOC 2 Type II report for full production onboarding. We do accept an attestation + remediation plan for early evaluation, but the Type II will be required before any PHI workloads go live. Our audit window is Q4; if you expect a report earlier, please flag it.

HIPAA/GDPR: HIPAA applies to the device telemetry and any identifiable health data. GDPR applies to EU users — we only have a small EU pilot but still need data processing terms aligned.

Retention expectations (Northstar initial asks):
- Application audit logs: 2 years (security investigations and regulatory requests).
- System/host logs: 1 year.
- Backups: nightly snapshots retained for 365 days; point-in-time older archives only on request.
- PHI in backups: backups may contain PHI; this is allowed but must be encrypted and keys must be managed per our KMS policy.
- Deletion SLA: For standard user data deletion requests, 45 days maximum. For PHI we expect formal signed confirmation of deletion due to audit trail requirements; target 90 days.

VSA: Attaching our questionnaire (northstar-vsa-initiated.pdf). It has a couple of free-text sections — please flag anything you cannot commit to and we can escalate.

Can we lock a 30-minute call on Mon 6/28 at 10am PT (we can move earlier if needed) to walk the VSA and RTO/RPO items?

Thanks — Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Platform Security, Northstar Labs
liam.oneill@northstarlabs.com
message_3_subject: Internal: Northstar VSA + retention asks — proposed responses
message_3_body:
Looping internal notes and suggested responses so we can move quickly on the VSA. Quoted Liam's answers below for context.

On retention windows:
- We should accept application audit logs retention of 2 years contractually (this is within our cost model but will increase log egress and storage — flag to pricing).
- System/host logs 1 year — OK.
- Backups retained 365 days: this is higher than our default. We should offer two options: standard (90 days) and enterprise (365 days) with pricing uplift.
- Deletion SLAs: Northstar asks 45 days for standard data and 90 days for PHI. Our standard is 30 days for non-PHI; we can agree to 45 days as a contract term for this account, but we need to document the operational steps to ensure deletion across backups and caches (notes on RDB snapshot purging + object-store lifecycle).

KMS / encryption note:
- We can confirm encryption at rest and in transit. For customer-managed keys (CMK) we need to check whether Northstar requires HSM-backed keys — this will change implementation timeline.

Action items:
1) Aditya: please draft VSA responses for the attached northstar questionnaire; mark any items that should be escalated to security/research (particularly around key management and deletion from backups).
2) Evelyn: confirm proposed call Mon 6/28 10am PT with Liam/Amira and include our Security partner if needed.
3) Ben: notify pricing to prepare a 365-day backup uplift option.

--Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
message_4_subject: Re: Post-demo: Northstar security checklist & log / deletion scope — call confirmed
message_4_body:
Thanks all — Monday 6/28 10am PT works for Northstar. We'll expect: VSA answers, SOC 2 summary, and proposed deletion timelines.

A couple clarifications from our side before the call:
- For CMK: we can accept either Redwood-managed keys or customer-managed keys in AWS KMS; HSM-backed keys are only required for specific regulated data subsets and we will flag them in the questionnaire.
- On deletion: Northstar's legal prefers a documented runbook for deletion from backups and for confirming completion. If Redwood can provide a standard runbook template, that will speed sign-off.

We'll review the attached VSA and circle back with any follow-up questions before the call. Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Amira Khan
Lead Security Operations, Northstar Labs
amira.k@northstarlabs.com
